question: Which chief minister launched the process of distributing 'Orunodoi Cards' to new beneficiaries in October 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himanta Biswa Sarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Himanta Biswa Sarma** is the current **Chief Minister of Assam**.
 
• He launched the process of distributing **'Orunodoi Cards'** to new beneficiaries in **October 2023**.
 
• The **Orunodoi Scheme** is a flagship welfare scheme of the Assam government aimed at providing financial assistance to economically disadvantaged families.
 
• The scheme primarily targets **women** as beneficiaries to ensure **economic empowerment** and better household management.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible households receive a monthly financial assistance of **Rs. 830**.
 
• The scheme covers a wide range of beneficiaries, including **widows, unmarried women, and differently-abled individuals**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **YS Jagan Mohan Reddy**__

 __
 
• **YS Jagan Mohan Reddy** is the current **Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• He is known for various welfare schemes like **YSR Rythu Bharosa** and **YSR Aarogyasri**.
 
 
 
• **Neiphiu Rio**__
 __
 
• **Neiphiu Rio** is the current **Chief Minister of Nagaland**.
 
• He has been in office since **2018** and previously served as Chief Minister from **2003 to 2014**.
 
 
 
• **Pinarayi Vijayan**__
 
 
• **Pinarayi Vijayan** is the current **Chief Minister of Kerala**.
 
• He is known for his **progressive policies** and handling of the **COVID-19 pandemic** in Kerala.
